#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BUN="<nda context deleted, size :29 chars>"
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CLI="$DIR/src/cli.ts"
DB="$DIR/.taskboard.test.json"
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$DB"

rm -f "$DB"

pass=0
fail=0

assert_json() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
  if [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
    pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL: $desc" >&2
    echo "  expected: $expected" >&2
    echo "  actual:   $actual" >&2
  fi
}

assert_exit() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2"
  if [ "$expected" = "0" ]; then
    pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL: $desc (exit $expected)" >&2
  fi
}

# add
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" add --title "Task A" --tags work,urgent --due 2026-12-31)
id=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).id)')
assert_json "add returns id 1" "1" "$id"

# add second
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" add --title "Task B" --tags home)
id2=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).id)')
assert_json "add returns id 2" "2" "$id2"

# list sorted by id
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" list)
count=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).length)')
assert_json "list has 2 tasks" "2" "$count"

# list filter by tag
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" list --tag work)
count=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).length)')
assert_json "list --tag work has 1" "1" "$count"

# list filter by status
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" list --status open)
count=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).length)')
assert_json "list --status open has 2" "2" "$count"

# done
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" done 1)
status=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).status)')
assert_json "done sets status" "done" "$status"

# done idempotent
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" done 1)
status=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).status)')
assert_json "done idempotent status" "done" "$status"

# list --status done
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" list --status done)
count=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).length)')
assert_json "list --status done has 1" "1" "$count"

# overdue filter (Task A due 2026-12-31, not overdue before 2026-09-03... actually overdue means due < D)
# Task A due 2026-12-31, overdue 2027-01-01 -> due < 2027-01-01 -> yes
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" list --overdue 2027-01-01)
count=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).length)')
assert_json "list --overdue 2027-01-01 has 1 (Task A open, due before)" "1" "$count"

# delete
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" delete 2)
id=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).id)')
assert_json "delete returns id 2" "2" "$id"

# list after delete
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" list)
count=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).length)')
assert_json "list after delete has 1" "1" "$count"

# stats
out=$("$BUN" run "$CLI" stats)
total=$(echo "$out" | "$BUN" -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()).total)')
assert_json "stats total" "1" "$total"

# error: empty title
"$BUN" run "$CLI" add --title "" 2>/dev/null && assert_exit "empty title should fail" "1" || assert_exit "empty title fails" "0"

# error: bad date
"$BUN" run "$CLI" add --title "X" --due 2026-13-45 2>/dev/null && assert_exit "bad date should fail" "1" || assert_exit "bad date fails" "0"

# error: missing task

# error: unknown command
"$BUN" run "$CLI" frobnicate 2>/dev/null && assert_exit "unknown command should fail" "1" || assert_exit "unknown command fails" "0"

# malformed DB
echo "not json" > "$DB"
"$BUN" run "$CLI" list 2>/dev/null && assert_exit "malformed DB should fail" "1" || assert_exit "malformed DB fails" "0"
# verify DB not replaced
content=$(cat "$DB")
assert_json "malformed DB preserved" "not json" "$content"

# atomic write: verify no temp files left
ls "$DIR"/.taskboard.test.json.* 2>/dev/null && assert_exit "temp files should not remain" "1" || assert_exit "no temp files remain" "0"

rm -f "$DB"

echo ""
echo "Passed: $pass"
echo "Failed: $fail"
[ "$fail" = "0" ]
